question: A 2-year-old child presents to the clinic with a complaint of difficulty feeding. On examination, his mid-upper-arm circumference is found to be less than 11 cm, and some palmar erythema is also observed. The child is able to finish ready-to-use therapeutic food (RUTF). How will you manage this child according to Integrated Management of Newborn and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines?

answers.option: Give IV glucose to treat low blood sugar

question: A 2-year-old presents to the emergency department with convulsions and edema of both feet and hands. On examination, his mid-upper arm circumference is 10.5 cm and the edema is pitting. answers.option: Cover the child with a warm blanket and additional clothing
Broad spectrum antibiotics ampicillin and gentamycin
70 mL of ReSoMal per Kg bodyweight

question: A 1-day-old infant comes to the clinic with the complaint of bilious vomiting since birth. There is no associated abdominal distention. A 10-year-old unimmunized child weighing 30 Kg, belonging to a poor socio-economic group, and a resident of urban slums presents to the outpatient department with complaints of high-grade continuous fever for 10 days. On examination, the patient has a toxic look, his tongue is coated, and the spleen is palpable 3 cm below the costal margin. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

answers.option: Partial thromboplastin time (PTT) and activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT)

question: Which of the following is the recommended dose of vitamin A in an infant less than 6 months of age diagnosed with measles?

question: A 7-day-old baby is brought to the emergency department with complaints of cyanosis since the second day of birth. On examination, he has an ejection systolic murmur at the left upper sternal border. Chest  X-ray shows an egg on string appearance. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A complete blood count shows a hemoglobin of 9 mg/dL, and a WBC count of 25000 per microlitre ( Lymphocytes = 25%, neutrophils = 65%). A 5-year-old child presents to the clinic with a history of difficulty in climbing stairs. On examination, there is hypertrophy of the calf muscles. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
